shared_elements: upright stela-shaped slab carved in low relief
human figure(s) shown in profile-like poses
dense field of script signs / glyphs
figure with elaborate headgear or head ornament
figures combined with adjacent text blocks
seated/standing figures with arms extended toward objects
justification: Both are upright relief-carved stelae combining human figures with dense blocks of non-alphabetic script signs, and in each a figure faces offerings/objects with text filling the surrounding field, which is a real but broad correspondence. They differ sharply in specifics: A shows one large frontal, elaborately costumed standing figure filling the whole shaft with glyphs confined to a small band, while B is divided into three horizontal registers of small seated/standing profile figures at tables, with fine, spare linear signs dominating; the figural proportions, costume conventions and register logic are unrelated.
